projects.heading: Chapter 5 Projects
projects.paragraph: Chapter 5 projects are available online at bit.ly/30IM8gT.

list.item: Power Method for Finding Eigenvalues: This project shows how to find the eigenvector associated with the eigenvalue corresponding to the largest eigenvalue.

Integration by Parts: The purpose of this project is to show how the matrix of a linear transformation relative to a basis B may be used to find antiderivatives usually found using integration by parts.
Robotics: In this project, students are asked to find online examples of robots that use 3D rotations to function.
Dynamical Systems and Markov Chains: This project applies the techniques of discrete dynamical systems to Markov chains.
